name: Ixhel
description: A planeswalker who compleats Geth into Vishgraz.

description_citations.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixhel flies up the Basilica's shaft from the Dross Pits, killing skitterlings on the way, to report her success.
timeline.quote: as you separate their heads from their bodies with a sweep of your spear

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa orders Ixhel to seek out and kill the traitor Geth, a Steel Thane of the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: I want you to seek him out, Ixhel. I want you to end him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa tells Ixhel she is her most perfect creation, and Ixhel feels a flare of something beyond loyalty.
timeline.quote: You are my most perfect creation.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel treks across the Dross Pits and finds a rock gate with sound plates in front of Geth's fortress.
timeline.quote: Stepping into the shadow of the rock face, you see the outline of a gate.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel pins a stammering aspirant who says he is Belaxis and has a contract with Lord Geth, whom he calls the Thane of Contracts.
timeline.quote: Lord Geth makes deals. That's why they call him the Thane of Contracts!

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Belaxis helps Ixhel crack the sound puzzle to open the gate and she gives him her name.
timeline.quote: The door flashes with a thin blue light, and the gate grinds open.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel walks through Geth's holding, noting the many aspirants and incompleat creatures, and reaches his fortress and empty throne.
timeline.quote: you do see more aspirants than you have in a long time.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Geth ambushes Ixhel, whom he mocks as a foot soldier, and speaks of loyalty that can be bought.
timeline.quote: The only true loyalty is that which can be bought.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Geth asks what Ixhel will have beyond her orthodoxy and the love of her mother, and chokes her.
timeline.quote: What about you, little emissary?

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel opens her own throat on Geth's blade to break free and beheads him.
timeline.quote: you bring down your blade in a single stroke, parting his head from his body.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel decides to help Geth's head and carries it to the Dominus of Pain.
timeline.quote: Maybe, in this, you can help him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel impales Belaxis on a spike of the Dominus of Pain, saying she is grateful.
timeline.quote: A piercing wail rings out across the wastes as you pin the writhing body in your arms down onto a razor-tipped spoke

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel uses the Surgical Bay to create a new being from the parts she took, and brings it to Atraxa.
timeline.quote: Except this time, you have made something.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa reacts with disdain, and Ixhel admits she wanted to make something, and names her creation Vishgraz.
timeline.quote: His name is Vishgraz.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa orders Ixhel to get rid of it and leaves.
timeline.quote: Get rid of it,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel realizes the new being carries Geth's head and her own wings, and tells him she wanted to save him.
timeline.quote: I wanted to save you,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel brings Vishgraz to the Dross Pits shaft and tells him to go, and he urges her to come; she refuses and calls him her first defiance.
timeline.quote: You are my first defiance. Now go.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel stays at the base of the shaft, feeling an ache to follow him, but does not.
timeline.quote: Deep in the center of you is an ache that wishes to follow him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Geth makes protective contracts with flawed aspirants; Atraxa sends Ixhel, who decapitates him.
timeline.quote: Ixhel decapitated him

citation.work: Geth
citation.text: "Geth", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ixhel kills Belaxis and builds Vishgraz from his and Geth's parts.
timeline.quote: used parts from his and Geth's bodies

citation.work: Geth
citation.text: "Geth", section "Vishgraz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vishgraz awakens and is ordered to destroy dissenting factions with poison.
timeline.quote: Vishgraz awoke to life under the blinding white sky of the Fair Basilica

citation.work: Geth
citation.text: "Geth", section "Vishgraz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vishgraz's stolen limbs disobey; Atraxa brands it a heretic and Ixhel abandons it in the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: Ixhel abandoned Vishgraz in the Dross Pits

citation.work: Geth
citation.text: "Geth", section "Vishgraz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geth is compleated into Vishgraz by Ixhel.
timeline.quote: he was compleated fully into Vishgraz by Ixhel

citation.work: New Phyrexia (plane)
citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Seven Steel Thanes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Atraxa fashioned Ixhel as a weapon.
relations.quote: I fashioned a weapon. That's what you are.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

pages_say.description: A winged Phyrexian warrior of the Fair Basilica created by Atraxa, sent to kill Geth, who instead creates a new being from his head.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

pages_say.description: Phyrexian angel who killed Geth and created Vishgraz.

citation.work: Geth
